description: This file defines the ReviewerRatingModel class within the OrangeHRM Performance API module. It models the reviewer rating data for performance reviews, implementing serialization and normalization features, and references the ReviewerRating entity. The class uses traits and interfaces for API data handling and is annotated for API documentation (OpenAPI).

classes.name: ReviewerRatingModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing and normalizing reviewer rating data in the Performance API, implementing the Normalizable interface and using traits for serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ReviewerRatingModel with a ReviewerRating entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
